model: N(t) = m (1 - exp(-(p+q) t)) / (1 + (q/p) exp(-(p+q) t)), t = years since launch
fit_method: grid least squares over p (120 log-spaced values, 1e-4 to 0.5) and q (151 values, 0 to 1.5), m solved in closed form, three refinements

main.source: Sultan, Farley and Lehmann (1990), A Meta-Analysis of Applications of Diffusion Models, Journal of Marketing Research 27(1), 70 to 77
main.m: set in Task 8 from conversion and the addressable segment

analogs.reason: No public national packaged-milk series. India: NDDB annual reports give liquid milk sales by dairy cooperatives (lakh litres per day), which excludes private dairies, so it is not national packaged volume; the reports were seen as search excerpts only, not opened. Packaged milk in India dates from the 1970s, so a 2017 to 2025 segment cannot identify a launch-anchored p. Pakistan: no Economic Survey or official series splits packaged from loose milk; only single-year industry estimates (3 to 5 percent formal share) and paid Euromonitor tables were found.
NSS and HCES rounds give item 152 at most three points (2011-12, 2022-23, 2023-24), and two need the author's microdata.gov.in registration. The protocol requires at least 5 annual points.

No public national series. Searches found only paid market reports (GlobalData, IMARC, Ken Research) and firm-level figures; no listed processor reports a national branded ready-to-cook chicken series. Pakistan: no public filing or trade series for branded frozen chicken.

analog_rule: protocol analogs.rule: a public national annual series of at least 5 points

us_stress.role: sensitivity only (decision 14); sales in USD stand in for adopters
us_stress.series_rule: first figure GFI published for each calendar year; later restatements listed separately
